title: CTU: up counter
summary: CTU increments its count CV on each rising edge of CU and sets Q when CV reaches the preset PV.

sections.heading: Behavior
sections.body:
- Each FALSE-to-TRUE change of **CU** increments **CV** by one (CTU detects the edge itself).
- **Q** is TRUE while CV >= **PV**.
- **R** (reset) sets CV to 0; it has priority over CU.
- CV does not increase beyond the maximum INT value.
